description:
FILED s540b (Opus 5.5, 2026-11-13), docs/speed-low-hanging-review-s540.md THE LIST #2.  Code sha 05806e16.

WHAT: `use constant DEBUG => 0;` emits `(p-sub pl-DEBUG (&rest %_args) (:prototype "") (progn %_args 0))` and every later `DEBUG` is `(p-scalar-ctx (pl-DEBUG))` -- a special binding plus a call through the p-sub frame.  perl's compiler INLINES a constant sub with a `()` prototype at every use compiled after it (and `NAME()` too); `&NAME` and `->NAME` stay calls.  So folding matches perl better than today: a later `*DEBUG = sub () {1}` does not change already-compiled uses in perl either ("Constant subroutine redefined").

MEASUREMENT (scratch/s540b/emitlev/constuse-B.lisp vs constuse-C.lisp = the same emission with `(p-scalar-ctx (pl-DEBUG))` replaced by `0`; 3 M iterations of `DEBUG > 2 and print ...; $t++`; ab.pl --emit, best of 7, legs/leg1.log): 0.116 -> 0.035 s whole run, -70.2 % (C/A +0.7 %).  perl: 0.04 s.
Prevalence: 1,613 `use constant` declarations in 321 of 3,797 .pm files (perl's lib + ~/.cpan/build); in the review's sample JSON::PP alone has 42 call sites of its literal constants.

SCOPE OF THE LEVER (what makes it one session): only a constant whose value is a LITERAL scalar (number, non-interpolating string) declared by `use constant` IN THIS UNIT, folded at uses AFTER the declaration in source order (position-aware: the #2871 lesson -- a prototype/constant applies below its definition only), spelled `NAME` or `NAME()`; never `&NAME`, never a method call, never a list constant (#2537), never a non-literal value (#2681: that one is evaluated once at the `use`, and folding it would freeze compile-time inputs into the CACHE -- DECIDED ## s525 Option-3 risk).  The fact already exists (Pl::Environment's constant record / proto_is_zero_arg); the emission is ExprToCL's call of a known zero-arg sub.  A Kind-A registry name (`const-fold`), so PCL_OPT=-const-fold is the A/B.

BAR: gate + sweep (constant rows: perl-tests/const*.t, the #2537 / #2681 / #3870 / #3521 guard rows), corpus-diff explained per file, everyday, the measurement above reproduced; a guard row that a constant redefined at RUN time after the use keeps the folded value (perl: same) and that `&NAME` still calls.

DO NOT: fold imported constants (their value is not in this unit's text); fold before the declaration; touch the glob-installed `BEGIN { *DEBUG = sub () {0} }` shape (Pod::Simple: 199 sites) -- that one is not known at transpile time; its cost is the anonymous sub's FRAME (-26.9 % vs a `use constant` sub, legs/leg1.log), which is s539d's frame subject.

=== RULED (the USER, s540, 2026-11-13) === the fold may be built PROVIDED an attempt to change the constant still fails.  Probed by the reviewing session (~/pcl-agent-scratch/s540/review/k/k1..k3.pl, perl 5.40.3 vs main 05806e16): `PI++` / `PI = 4` -- perl refuses at compile time; main runs `PI++` as a SILENT NO-OP and drops `PI = 4` at run time.  `$$r = 5` through `\PI` and `for my $v (PI) { $v++ }` -- perl dies "Modification of a read-only value attempted"; main lets both live.  `*PI = sub () {9}` -- perl's later bare PI stays 3, &PI and main->PI are 9; main answers 9 9 9.  So the batch adds: a modifying operator on a folded constant is refused at transpile time; the folded value is read-only where aliased or referenced.  s540/s540d-prompt.md member 4, DECIDED ## s540.

=== RULED AGAIN (the USER, s540, 2026-11-13, later the same day) === Perl code is assumed correct (principle 9): NOTHING is built for a program that modifies a constant -- no transpile-time refusal, no new read-only machinery.  The folded value is the literal at that position.  The only check: the three probe files (review/k/) end no worse than a tidy failure on the tree.  This supersedes the condition in the note above.
subject: PERF (s540b, measured): a LITERAL `use constant NAME => 0` is a full sub call + a scalar-context bind at EVERY use -- perl inlines it; folding the literal at the use site is -70 % on a constant-check loop (~30 ns a use; `DEBUG > 2 and ...`, `$self->[FIELD]`)
